usage: kala-agent [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] command ...

Local, offline engineering design agent over the declarative domain packages.
Every command prints one JSON document and returns an exit code. No
authentication, no network access.

positional arguments:
  command
    init               Create or verify the local data directory and report
                       local facts.
    domains            List every registered domain package and workflow
                       definition.
    token              Print the bearer token of the running local API launch.
    serve              Serve the local API on the loopback interface until
                       interrupted.
    evaluate           Evaluate one reference design of a domain package.
    run-mechanical     Run the mechanical reference workflow to its policy
                       checkpoint.
    workflow-status    Print the current state of one workflow.
    approve            Approve the pending policy checkpoint of a workflow.

parser.description: Run the Kala Studio standalone HTTP service on a loopback interface. The host defaults to 127.0.0.1 and is refused for anything else; the token is taken from KALA_STUDIO_TOKEN or minted into the studio data directory. With --worker the same command runs the internal geometry worker instead (ADR-0010).
parser.epilog: Exit codes: 0 served; 1 the uvicorn module is not installed; 2 a usage error occurred.

top_level_options.help: show this help message and exit
loopback address; refused if not 127.0.0.1, ::1, or localhost

absolute path to the studio data directory; with --worker it is required (KALA_STUDIO_DATA_DIR is accepted instead); otherwise it defaults to the standard Kala data directory or the system temporary folder
override the static UI directory; otherwise the studio uses the frozen or repo-relative dist directory
run the internal geometry worker (ADR-0010): bind 127.0.0.1:0, require KALA_WORKER_TOKEN (at least 32 characters), and print one KALA_WORKER_READY line; --host, --port, and --static-dist are ignored
